title: QuietLink paste state.json (schema_version 1)
description: Mutable per-paste state, rewritten only under an exclusive flock() on state.lock via temp file + fsync + rename() (spec §9.4, §9.4.1, §6.3.1). Never contains plaintext, keys, passphrase, raw reservation identifier or raw deletion token. Encodings are Proposed (non-normative); see docs/storage-format.md.

schema_version.description: Storage format version of this file. Readers fail closed on any other value (ADR-0002).

state.description: Persistent state. 'deleted' is a technical state written at the start of a deletion (§9.4.1). Expiry is not a state: it is derived from meta.json expires_at.

terminal_at.description: Unix seconds of the transition to 'consumed' or 'deleted'; null otherwise.

unconfirmed_opens.description: Number of reservations released without confirmation (§6.3.1 step 7).

reservation.description: Current or last reservation. null when no reservation is active and none led to consumption.

id_hash.description: Hash of the 128-bit client-generated reservation identifier (never the raw identifier).

consume_challenge.description: Consume challenge bound to this reservation (82 raw bytes, base64url without padding), stored as-is (§6.3.1); not a secret.

expires_at.description: Reservation expiry, Unix seconds (created_at of reservation + read_once_reservation_ttl, 30..300 s). Never extended by a resume.

consumed_signature_hash.description: Hash of the Ed25519 signature that consumed the paste; null unless consumed by a valid consume request.
